records.source: DART MAN: Well, shiver me timbers! That's a perfect game!
records.translation: 飛鏢手：我的老天！這是完美的一局！

records.source: DART MAN: Well, sink me! That's some good throwing!
records.translation: 飛鏢手：我的天！投得真不錯！

records.source: Here's a little something for ya.
records.translation: 送你一點小東西。

records.source: Come back again any time!
records.translation: 隨時歡迎再來！

records.source: DART MAN: Yar... Better luck next time...
records.translation: 飛鏢手：呀……下次好運……

records.source: BARTENDER: Oi! I never seen the likes o' you, before. But if ye got the pirate look, then 'ave one on me! Har Har!
records.translation: 酒保：喂！以前從沒見過你這號人物。不過既然打扮得像海盜，這杯我請！哈、哈！

records.source: BARTENDER: Back fer more, eh? Har Har! You've had enough, matey...
records.translation: 酒保：又來討一杯，對吧？哈、哈！你已經喝夠了，夥伴……

records.source:
------------------------------
			 --Monster Eradication Goals--
             "Help us keep the valley safe."
------------------------------
A new chick hatched... It looks odd.
records.translation: 一隻新雛雞孵化了……看起來很奇怪。

records.source: A new baby chick hatched!
records.translation: 一隻小雛雞孵化了！

records.source: A new baby duckling hatched!
records.translation: 一隻小鴨孵化了！

records.source: A new baby ...lizard?... hatched.
records.translation: 一隻小……蜥蜴？……孵化了。

records.source: Opens at 5pm.
records.translation: 下午五點開放。

records.source: The submarine is currently in use. Come back later.
records.translation: 潛水艇目前正在使用中。請稍後再來。

records.source: Merchant: The night market starts at 5pm... visit me then for a free cup of coffee!
records.translation: 商人：夜市下午五點開始……到時候來找我，免費喝一杯咖啡！

records.source: Merchant: Hello there! Care for a cup of coffee?
records.translation: 商人：你好！想喝杯咖啡嗎？

records.source: Merchant: Mmm... smells great, doesn't it?
records.translation: 商人：嗯……聞起來很香，對吧？

records.source: Famous Painter Lupini: Come back when the market opens, if you wish to purchase my fine work.
records.translation: 知名畫家盧皮尼：如果想購買我的精美作品，請在市集開放後再來。

records.source: Famous Painter Lupini: I'm selling this painting for 1200g. What do you say?
records.translation: 知名畫家盧皮尼：這幅畫售價 1200g。意下如何？

records.source: Famous Painter Lupini: My apologies... I have no more paintings to sell today.
records.translation: 知名畫家盧皮尼：很抱歉……今天已經沒有其他畫作可賣。

records.source: Shrouded Figure: I can send you home for 250g.
records.translation: 蒙面身影：支付 250g，我可以送你回家。

records.source: Use 300 pieces of wood to fix the bridge?
records.translation: 要使用三百塊木材修復橋梁嗎？

records.source: Hmmm... With 300 pieces of wood this could be fixed.
records.translation: 嗯……用三百塊木材就能修好。

records.source:
Gone fishing.

   I'll be back tomorrow.
records.translation:
去釣魚了。

   明天回來。

records.translation: 姑娘

records.source: Old Mariner: Glad the amulet worked out for ye, {0}.
records.translation: 老水手：很高興那枚護符替你帶來了好結果，{0}。

records.source: Old Mariner: Don't be shy, now. Show that amulet to the one you intend to marry.
records.translation: 老水手：別害羞。把那枚護符拿給你想娶的人看。

records.source: Old Mariner: I can see that sparkle in yer eye, {0}. Ye must be head over heels in love. But I'm afraid a bigger house is essential for a happy marriage.
records.translation: 老水手：我看得見你眼中的光芒，{0}。你一定深深墜入了愛河。不過要有幸福婚姻，恐怕少不了一棟更大的房子。

records.source: Old Mariner: Ah, I can see it in yer eyes... There be a special someone in yer heart. Just so happens I'm sellin' a 'Mermaid's Pendant'. Give that to yer intended and they'll know exactly what you mean.
records.translation: 老水手：啊，我從你的眼神看得出來……心裡住著一個特別的人。正巧我在賣一枚「美人魚墜飾」。把它送給心上人，對方就會完全明白你的心意。

records.source: Buy (5000g)
Not now...
records.translation: 現在不要……

records.source: Old Mariner: I've got this old amulet to sell... but somethin' tells me yer not ready for it, {0}.
records.translation: 老水手：我有一枚老護符要賣……不過直覺告訴我，你還沒準備好，{0}。
